The operating company directly providing **Vimeo** at **vimeo.com** is **Vimeo.com, Inc.**

### Evidence & Provider Statement
* According to the **Vimeo Terms of Service Agreement** governing **vimeo.com** and its associated services:
  > *"This Vimeo Terms of Service Agreement (the “Agreement” or “Terms of Service”) is made between Vimeo.com, Inc. (“Vimeo,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) and you, our customer (“you” or “your”). This Agreement governs your use of Vimeo owned-and-operated websites, applications, and embeddable video players (collectively, the “Services”)."*
* Official website footer notices and mobile application listings similarly identify the operating entity and developer as **Vimeo.com, Inc.** (e.g., *"TM + © 2025 Vimeo.com, Inc. All rights reserved."*).
